appCandidates.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: standalone Windows desktop application icon candidate for PatinaTorrent, a lean Rust BitTorrent client inspired by the compact classic 2011 desktop era.
Primary request: create one beautiful original app icon: a dark oxidized teal enamel circular medallion with a fine warm copper rim, carrying a bold warm-ivory capital P. The vertical stem of the P ends in a clear downward arrow point so the monogram also suggests downloading. Keep the P unmistakably readable, with one generously open rounded counter. The mark is simple and custom drawn.
Style/medium: polished professional app icon, crisp vector-like silhouette, restrained tactile enamel and brushed copper shading. Nostalgic desktop utility, refined and durable.
Composition/framing: single icon centered, front-facing orthographic, square canvas, occupies 84% width with transparent margins. No ground plane.
Color palette: rich patina teal #176D63 and #103E39, copper #B77A4C, warm ivory #F4EEE0.
Constraints: actual transparent alpha background, no text outside the monogram, no captions, no watermark, no UI mockup. Three large simple shapes; no decorative ticks, no distressed noise, no thin details, no external drop shadow. Recognizable when reduced to 32 pixels. Original artwork, no existing torrent-client marks or Rust logo.

Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: standalone Windows desktop application icon candidate for PatinaTorrent, a lean Rust BitTorrent client with a classic compact desktop UI.
Primary request: create one beautiful original app icon around a circular exchange symbol: two broad curved ribbon arrows chase one another around a generous open central aperture, the right ribbon descending and the left ribbon ascending, communicating peer-to-peer transfer. One continuous ribbon is warm pale copper, the other is warm ivory. Their angular arrowheads remain obvious at small sizes. Mount the symbol on a deep oxidized teal softly rounded square tile with a restrained beveled edge.
Style/medium: crisp professionally designed app icon with simple geometric silhouettes and subtle enamel/metal shading, compact classic desktop utility feeling, restrained, pleasing optical balance.
Composition/framing: single icon centered front-facing orthographic on a square canvas, tile fills 84% width; no perspective. Transparent outside the tile.
Color palette: patina teal #185B53, copper #C98A57, warm ivory #F4EEE0.
Constraints: actual transparent alpha background, no letters, no text, no captions, no watermark, no UI mockup, no ground plane, no external drop shadow. Keep exactly two bold arrows around one open hole. No busy textures, no delicate lines, no extra orbiting nodes. Clean silhouette at 32 pixels. Original artwork, no existing brand logos.

Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: standalone Windows desktop application icon candidate for PatinaTorrent, a lean Rust BitTorrent client inspired by classic desktop software.
Primary request: create one beautiful original app icon: a compact eight-tooth copper gear badge with a deep patina teal inset circular center. Inside the teal center is one bold warm-ivory downward arrow above a short thick tray bar. Gear teeth are broad rounded trapezoids with generous spacing, clearly a durable utility emblem; center and arrow are perfectly legible. This is an original gear design, not the Rust language logo.
Style/medium: premium classic desktop icon, polished crisp vector-like form with subtle brushed copper bevel and smooth enamel shading. Restrained industrial character, solid and welcoming.
Composition/framing: one icon centered front-facing orthographic, square canvas, gear fills 84% width. Transparent outside the silhouette, generous corners.
Color palette: copper #B87B49 with muted bronze shadows, teal #176D63 and #103E39, ivory #F4EEE0.
Constraints: actual transparent alpha background, no text, no letters, no captions, no watermark, no UI mockup, no ground plane or external shadow. One simple arrow and one tray bar. No bolts, rivets, distressed texture or decorative microdetails. Clear silhouette and broad arrow at 32 pixels. Do not reproduce existing marks.
